# Mendieta Roofing Corp.

> Family-owned and operated roofing company in West Palm Beach, Florida, in roofing since 1988. Tile, asphalt shingle and flat roofs for homes and commercial buildings, from repairs to full replacements, across Palm Beach and Broward counties. Florida license CCC1328504, Certified Roofing Contractor, held by Mario M. Mendieta for Mendieta Roofing Corp.; licensed since March 10, 2008, current and active through August 31, 2028 (Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation). Office (561) 797-5457; cell (561) 543-6287, for calls and texts. Payment: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover and PayPal.

## Roofs

- [Tile](https://mendietaroofingcorp.com/#roofs): tile roof repair and replacement. Barrel or flat tile, terracotta or white.
- [Asphalt shingle](https://mendietaroofingcorp.com/#roofs): shingle roof repair and replacement.
- [Flat roofs](https://mendietaroofingcorp.com/#roofs): flat foam and single-ply roof repair.

## How a new tile roof goes on

- [Layer by layer](https://mendietaroofingcorp.com/#layers): the old roof comes off, all the way down to the wood deck. Underlayment covers the whole deck before any tile goes on. The tile is loaded onto the roof in stacks, then laid course by course from the bottom edge up. Every photo on the page is from one of their jobs, including two houses shown during the work and finished, in white tile and in terracotta.

## Materials

GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed, Tamko, Elk, LeafGuard, Allied Construction Industries and Roof Tile Solutions.
